def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The sparse color in the field is the color used to extend the border bars.
    inner = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] != bg and r not in (0, h - 1) and c not in (0, w - 1)]
    if not inner:
        return out
    fill = grid[inner[0][0]][inner[0][1]]

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r, c) in inner:
                out[r][c] = 4

    # Bars on an edge extend inward across the grid, using their aligned span.
    for edge in ("top", "bottom", "left", "right"):
        n = w if edge in ("top", "bottom") else h
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            r, c = ((0, i) if edge == "top" else
                    (h - 1, i) if edge == "bottom" else
                    (i, 0) if edge == "left" else (i, w - 1))
            color = grid[r][c]
            j = i + 1
            while j < n:
                rr, cc = ((0, j) if edge == "top" else
                          (h - 1, j) if edge == "bottom" else
                          (j, 0) if edge == "left" else (j, w - 1))
                if grid[rr][cc] != color:
                    break
                j += 1
            length = j - i
            if color != bg and length >= 3:
                for k in range(i + 1, j):
                    for d in range(1, h - 1 if edge in ("top", "bottom") else w - 1):
                        rr, cc = ((d, k) if edge == "top" else
                                  (h - 1 - d, k) if edge == "bottom" else
                                  (k, d) if edge == "left" else
                                  (k, w - 1 - d))
                        if grid[rr][cc] == bg:
                            out[rr][cc] = fill
            i = j
    return out
